title: Kunoichi
summary: Kunoichi is a four-eyed, ninja-warrior Yama-Titan. She wears blue and red armor and has long blue hair. Armed with a katana, Kunoichi is a fast and agile fighter. A Kunoichi Amulet is in the possession of Santiago.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Santiago acquired Kunoichi's Amulet at an unknown time.

Santiago invoked Kunoichi in the great battle at the Blood Spiral Base. Kunoichi defeated numerous Bazela's Insect Titans. [Lok and the Betrayer]

Later on in the battle, Kunoichi cut a hole in a Scramjet to rescue LeBlanche. Santiago, LeBlanche and Kunoichi then jumped to safety before the Scram-jet exploded. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Kunoichi can move quickly, being able to jump great distances. She can use a katana or use her martial arts to defeat her enemies.
